metaDescription: Order a hand-drawn One Piece wanted poster custom from your photo. Preview within 72 hours, unlimited free revisions, from $34.99.
heroHeading: Your Face. Your Bounty. Your Wanted Poster.
description: Turn your portrait into a wanted poster-inspired piece of pirate wall art with Anime Cabinet. A human artist hand-draws your likeness from the photo you provide, then places it in an iconic parchment-style layout with a bold DEAD OR ALIVE heading, custom epithet, and bounty number. The result captures the fun of the anime’s visual language while presenting you as an original character—not an impersonation of a copyrighted character. It is a personal, playful take on the classic bounty poster format: your face, your story, and a bounty chosen by you.

This one piece wanted poster custom commission starts from $34.99 and makes an unforgettable one piece wanted poster custom gift for birthdays, graduations, anniversaries, fandom celebrations, or anyone who has ever joked about the price on their head. Order a solo portrait, a matching couple set with linked bounties, a best-friend poster, or even a wanted poster for your pet. Clear, front-facing photos work best, especially when the expression, eyes, brows, and hairline are visible. You can also tell us the name, epithet, bounty, wording, expression, and any small details you want included.

After you submit your order, an artist creates your custom anime portrait from photo and sends a preview within 72 hours. Unlimited free revisions are included, so you can request adjustments until the mugshot feels recognisably yours. Choose a digital artwork or ask for a custom anime portrait canvas for ready-to-display wall art. Anime Cabinet offers 24 anime and cartoon-inspired styles, all created by human artists. Explore the [One Piece portrait collection](/portraits/one-piece), browse the [wanted poster-inspired custom poster guide](/blog/one-piece-wanted-poster-inspired-custom-poster), or find more ideas in our [gift guide for One Piece wanted poster fans](/blog/best-gifts-for-one-piece-wanted-poster-fans).

faqs.q: Where can I order a custom One Piece wanted poster with my portrait, and how much does it cost?
faqs.a: You can order a one piece wanted poster custom directly from Anime Cabinet, with prices starting from $34.99. Each commission is hand-drawn by a human artist, and the preview arrives within 72 hours. Unlimited free revisions are included before you approve the final artwork.

faqs.q: Can I turn my photo into a personalized One Piece wanted poster, and what details should I provide?
faqs.a: Yes. Upload a clear front-facing photo and provide the name, custom epithet, bounty amount, preferred expression, and any wording or design notes. A simple background is ideal because the artwork uses a parchment-inspired poster setting. Our artists preserve recognisable facial details while creating an original character in a One Piece-inspired visual language. Anime Cabinet creates high-quality custom anime wanted posters across 24 hand-drawn styles, with digital and custom anime portrait canvas options available.
